blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 451632419, the sole tracked HYUSD mint 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E is an 82-byte legacy SPL Token mint owned by TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, with freezeAuthority null and mintAuthority CfuSViqf6wvUKEprLhtuCsSanvfAsMbDmkAW92FP95qe. It has no Token-2022 permanent delegate, transfer hook, default-account-state or pausable extension. The SPL program requires holder/delegate authorization for transfers and cannot restore a null freeze authority. Hylo's exchange program HYEXCHtHkBagdStcJCp3xbbb9B7sdMdWXFNj6mdsG4hn remains upgradeable: at slot 451632721 its ProgramData BA5b6FzvZ77m7MZbsMEVSCFW1x86f7jM98wjcecVwzYN names GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP as upgrade authority, last upgraded at slot 447625876. That controls issuance and protocol vaults, not arbitrary holder-owned SPL accounts. The live registry contains only jitoSOL and hyloSOL, both legacy SPL mints with null freezeAuthority. At slot 451632721, vault balances and same-slot Pyth prices timestamped 2026-09-29T11:47:31Z value jitoSOL at 78.22311035%, hyloSOL at 6.87885849%, cbBTC at 8.66189229%, HYPE at 6.23613887%, and USDC at approximately 0.000000000211% of $41,693,494.85 collateral. cbBTC and USDC have non-null freeze authorities, giving 8.66189229% confirmed issuer-controlled collateral; including all HYPE bridge exposure gives 14.89803116%, below the strict >50% upstream threshold. HYPE's local legacy SPL mint also has null freezeAuthority. At slot 451633551, jitoSOL's stake-pool program SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy has upgrade authority dPpFfahSWhm5M2RB3nVaHsXfnh9ooz5bWtR3WeUguDH and hyloSOL's program SPMBzsVUuoHA4Jm6KunbsotaahvVikZs1JyTW6iJvbn has upgrade authority 47SND7bGKvNXrqfP1bjsLCbwTgZhFBzAgmZ42QSkRScz. Those authorities can change staking and reserve logic but cannot replace the holder-facing SPL token program. Whether protocol-governed LST upgradeability alone counts as possible-class upstream exposure remains an owner-level policy question: counting both LSTs gives 93.76386113% exposure before HYPE, implying inherited; excluding those protocol-only controls leaves No. The stored No verdict is retained pending that policy decision. This corrects the obsolete 5.319864% USDC and dust-cbBTC composition.

oracleRisk.summary: Exact Alchemy archive reads at finalized Solana slot 455400000 (hash 2Dx6qLz4qicFE1TTQANYLEF66E9zfmj8my885xPzQd8a; 2026-10-10T21:15:23Z), observed 2026-10-11, corroborate the official SDK v2.0.5 account layouts: state 9cd2sAfbBvKs4SX9YKo4dcjwP3TgTVQ8dT5koshGcDND selects Pyth SOL/USD 7AviUf9nL62mcxNbQGKm4nKDQnPjswo6c5MX4D57HmyE; cbBTC pair 8mgw2TsNxTMndWPyswLELw3V2tPrPvtqS7Ex9RyiGhML selects BTC/USD APgzQGGdv2qCgBkX6aHVkrGePtBVDDg68GiqaM7rmtf5; HYPE pair 42GzNWvZ1H1hwXaBZ8mbeVZaSEgh6zMm8BABdS3v1BEB selects HYPE/USD 9dAoWJ5ua81c43ntstN4xyg3Uo9Zt93x7BjCxSc27V6V. All three serialize a 10-second interval and 0.01 confidence-ratio tolerance. USDC pair CMNPACEDebyvNJDgBxRc5fbScF8kmx52ZPBY4Cu4wuwS serializes 60 seconds, 0.001 confidence tolerance and 0.001 par tolerance; SDK candidate USDC/USD account 6HAuqASbHEh4w4REJEUUUCginTLfj1kwCh215ZLtMkrT is independently pinned, but UsdcPair stores no oracle address and the IDL does not establish its enforced deployed binding. All four pinned PriceUpdateV2 accounts are receiver-owned, Full-verified, carry the matching SDK feed IDs and self-named write authorities. Registry 9Mb2Mt76AN7eNY3BBA4LgfTicARXhcEEokTBfsN47noK lists jitoSOL header 8Ri52tZXZehgAHKbx1MQiXhWXXkVsvAL9op6C5HytDKF / SPL pool Jito4APyf642JPZPx3hGc6WWJ8zPKtRbRs4P815Awbb and hyloSOL header GMC2Q4ukPjiMjnhmxpZHDThQ4znC8oBAdveL62Tcu9rK / SanctumSplMulti pool hy1oDeVCVRDGkxS26qLVDvRhDpZGfWJ6w9AMvwMegwL; both cache epoch-1054 SOL exchange rates. These account/configuration facts do not verify deployed enforcement: Otter's HYEXCH verification status is false with no source/hash match. SDK freshness, confidence, epoch and par validators remain candidate implementation evidence, not a known deployed aggregate tier.

branchApplicability.rationale: Reviewed 2026-10-11T12:10:31Z. Exact archive state at slot 455400000 now establishes documented SOL/BTC/HYPE configured accounts and serialized oracle settings, the two registered LST headers/pool states, and current authority identities; lack of pinned account-read support is no longer the blocker. HYEXCH ProgramData BA5b6FzvZ77m7MZbsMEVSCFW1x86f7jM98wjcecVwzYN still names upgrade authority GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP (last upgrade slot 447625876), while Hylo state names admin 12DAP8y5XemtK1pJFNMVVnQugt3PUAbZZr9SmyVvy4Ce. The registry's static entries include Sanctum's SPL calculator sp1V4h2gWorkGhVcazBc22Hfo2f5sd7jcjT4EDPrWFF / state 7orJ4kDhn1Ewp54j29tBzUWDFGhyimhYi7sxybZcphHd and SanctumSplMulti calculator ssmbu3KZxgonUtjEMCKspZzxvUQCxAFnyh1rcHUeEDo / state Ehcuy2BzuY9BscqcH2K43tDKqoi6xQHxChtVjzrMfvU8. Exact program/ProgramData reads bind both calculators' upgrade authority to 47SND7bGKvNXrqfP1bjsLCbwTgZhFBzAgmZ42QSkRScz; their actual Hylo invocation, calculator-state enforcement and controller quorum remain unproven. The official IDL assigns oracle/configuration updates to an admin signer but is not executable-source verification. The V2 audit explicitly labels the exchange build unverified and acknowledges an LST swap path omitting stake withdrawal fees; it cannot certify all paths use Sanctum fee-adjusted pricing. Missing exact deployed source correspondence leaves actual account validation, USDC feed binding, LST calculation/update enforcement, freshness/confidence fail-closed behavior and complete applicable-path inventory unresolved. The SDK's four additional exogenous candidates are not promoted to live branches, and no calculator CPI, privileged-control quorum or aggregate protective tier is inferred from names or account layouts.
